purpose: Single step of Kuramoto oscillator model for swarm synchronization
description: Computes one time step of the Kuramoto model: dθᵢ/dt = ωᵢ + (K/N)Σⱼ sin(θⱼ - θᵢ). Used for oscillator synchronization, swarm coherence, and heartbeat coordination in NOVA.

signatures.motoko: kuramoto_step(oscillators: [(Float, Float)], K: Float, dt: Float) : async [(Float, Float)]
signatures.candid: kuramoto_step : (vec record { phase: float64; frequency: float64 }, float64, float64) -> (vec record { phase: float64; frequency: float64 })
signatures.javascript: async kuramocoStep(oscillators: Array<{phase, frequency}>, K: number, dt: number)

input_types.name: oscillators
input_types.description: Array of (phase θ, natural frequency ω) pairs

input_types.name: K
input_types.constraints: K > 0. Use K = φ⁻¹ = 0.618... for optimal coupling

input_types.name: dt
input_types.constraints: dt > 0. Use dt = HEARTBEAT_MS/1000 = 0.873 for NOVA heartbeat

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Updated phase θ after time step

numerical_caveats: Coupling K must be positive for synchronization
Large N requires O(N²) coupling computations

examples.description: 16 oscillators with random initial phases, φ-optimal coupling
examples.notes: After 100 heartbeat cycles, oscillators synchronize to R > φ⁻¹

code_samples.julia:
oscillators = [(2π * rand(), 1.0) for _ in 1:16]
println("Initial R: ", order_parameter(oscillators))

for _ in 1:100
    oscillators = kuramoto_step(oscillators, PHI_INV, HEARTBEAT_MS/1000)
end

println("Final R: ", order_parameter(oscillators))
